posts.title: You need a registry cleaner

slides.text: THE TRUTH — Windows manages the registry fine on its own. 'Registry cleaners' fix problems you don't have and can break working installs.

posts.title: Set up 2FA on any account

slides.text:
Set up 2FA on any account
Open Settings > Security > Two-factor
Prefer an authenticator app over SMS
Scan the QR with your authenticator
Save this — you'll need it next time.
